name: research
description: Find information and verify it before trusting it — search the live web with Exa, answer only from citable official sources or refuse (cite-or-refuse), rule every factual claim in a document VALID / INVALID / INCONCLUSIVE with sources (fact-check-document), automate a real headless Chromium browser (Playwright) for JS-heavy or interactive pages, and run BrightData's full scraping toolkit — web search, structured web-data feeds, a scraping browser, and the Web Unlocker (for pages that block ordinary scraping: 403/429, Cloudflare, CAPTCHA, geo-restriction, JS-only) — through the Bright Data MCP (brightdata). Supply an Exa API key to enable web search; supply Cloudflare Access credentials to enable Playwright and the Bright Data MCP.

EXA_API_KEY.title: Exa API Key
EXA_API_KEY.description: API key for Exa web search (https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys), sent as the x-api-key header to the hosted MCP at https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp. Stored in your system keychain, never written to the repo; maintainer copy is SOPS-encrypted in secrets/exa.sops.json.

PLAYWRIGHT_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.title: Playwright — CF Access Client ID
PLAYWRIGHT_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.description: CF-Access-Client-Id for playwright.loup-peluso.com (per-MCP service token; public identifier, ends in .access).

PLAYWRIGHT_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Playwright — CF Access Client Secret
PLAYWRIGHT_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: CF-Access-Client-Secret for playwright.loup-peluso.com. Stored in your system keychain; maintainer copy SOPS-encrypted in secrets/cloudflare-access.sops.json.
